Currency Act
(Chapter 69)
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denominations and characteristics of the coins to be issued on 28th May 2006 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE 2006 HERITAGE ORCHIDS OF SINGAPORE COINS TO BE ISSUED ON 28TH MAY 2006

Milled and bearing the words “MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE” and lion symbol.
The Singapore Arms in the centre with the year-date “2006” below it and the word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’clock of the coin.
The coin design features the orchid “Vanda Tan Chay Yan” in full colour in the centre and the name of the orchid at the right of the coin. The weight in grams and fineness of the coin are at the upper-left circumference. The denomination is at the lower-left of the coin.
